datasets.title: Kakamega Heatmap For Plant Pest 2025
datasets.description: This heatmap illustrates the spatial distribution of pest, disease, and weed occurrences affecting maize, beans, and potatoes in Kakamega County as of 2025. Developed under the Risk Management System for Plant Pests and Diseases project, it integrates field survey data, Earth observation inputs, and surveillance reports to support early warning and targeted response planning. The dataset is geospatially enabled for use in mapping and decision-support tools, with validated data against historical records and expert assessments to ensure accuracy. The legend of the heatmap reflects the level of infestation, categorized into five classes: Minimal, Low, Moderate, Notable, and Significant. This classification aids in interpreting the intensity of outbreaks across different locations. The dataset is intended to inform policy, research, and farm-level interventions aimed at enhancing crop protection and food security. Access is subject to licensing conditions as outlined by the Plant Protection and Food Safety Directorate (PPFSD) and the Regional Centre for Mapping of Resources for Development (RCMRD).
